context: Looking ahead to the next race
purpose: Set new goals; teach 競技/スキル/マシン/エリア/必死/武器/神経/競馬

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次の競技、もう照準を合わせてる。
lines.en: I’m already aiming for the next competition.
lines.style: driven athlete looking ahead, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: スキルの幅、広げていきたいね。
lines.en: I want to widen my range of skills too.
lines.style: friend matching ambition, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しいマシンを試したい。
lines.en: I want to try a new machine.
lines.style: athlete planning, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 練習エリアの予約、取っとくよ。
lines.style: helpful friend, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 必死に頑張る姿、応援する側も力をもらえる。
lines.en: Watching desperate effort gives the cheering side strength too.
lines.style: athlete reflecting on mutual support, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 君の武器、まだまだ伸びるよ。
lines.en: Your weapon still has room to grow.
lines.style: friend encouraging, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 神経を整えて、また挑戦する。
lines.en: I’ll steady my nerves and challenge again.
lines.style: athlete vowing, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 競馬みたいに、ペース配分も大事だね。
lines.en: Like in horse racing, pacing matters too.
lines.style: friend offering a tip, voice clear and distinctly their own
